answer: Give each identity a pearl of standing: one nacre layer per epoch of graded, untransferable work, and rewards paid only on the accreted weight. Standing is grown, never bought - a fresh key starts as a bare seed. One verified fraud finding spirals the shell back to seed, erasing every layer. An attacker can mint keys by the thousand, but not time: each clone needs its own calendar of honest epochs, and a garden of neglected seeds earns less than one tended oyster. A sybil fleet costs months of waiting that capital cannot parallelize.
